raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

aiter decode on the non-MLA path calls `paged_attention_ragged` with `max_num_partitions = ceil(context_len / 256)`: 512 for Llama-3.1-8B, 160 for Qwen3-8B. The main kernel's grid is `(num_seqs, max_num_partitions, num_kv_heads)` and the value is baked into every decode CUDA graph. Blocks past a sequence's length exit early, but launching and scheduling them still costs time, and at high batch the cost is no longer hidden behind real work. In the microbench below, at batch 64 / 1536 tokens P=512 costs 19.8 µs more per call than P=16 (0.63 ms per 32-layer step); at batch 256 it costs 274 µs more (+93%).

## Modifications

- `graph_variants.py`: new `SeqLenBucketGraphVariants` picks the first bucket whose limit covers `max(seq_lens_cpu)`, else the fallback. It reads only the host copy; a missing, empty or device tensor selects the fallback.
- `base_attn_backend.py`, `decode_cuda_graph_runner.py`: `AttentionBackend.get_decode_graph_variants` returns None by default; the decode runner asks the backend after the DSA / DSV4.1 factories and reuses the existing variant capture and replay code.
- `aiter_backend.py`: buckets `p16` (up to 4096 tokens) and `p128` (up to 32768), each kept only when 4x its partition count is at most `max_num_partitions`, plus `pmax` for any length. Llama gets p16 / p128 / p512, Qwen3 gets p16 / p160, models with fewer than 128 partitions get no buckets. Only plain decode with one token per request on the `paged_attention_ragged` path gets variants. Eager decode uses the same table when `spec_info` is None and `seq_lens_cpu` is present, so aiter never JIT-builds a new reduce kernel while serving. Spec decode, graphs captured without a variant, and the sync-free path without `seq_lens_cpu` keep `max_num_partitions`; an unknown capture label raises. The chosen count goes into the new `ForwardMetadata.decode_num_partitions`. Every choice keeps `partitions * 256 >= max seq_len`, since fewer partitions drop KV silently. The workspace stays sized for `max_num_partitions`.
- `environ.py`, `environment_variables.mdx`: `SGLANG_AITER_DECODE_PARTITION_BUCKETS` (default true); false disables bucketing.
- Tests: new `test_aiter_decode_partition_buckets.py` (AMD CI); `test_aiter_fp8_kv_scales_paths.py` and `test_aiter_fp8_q_unified_attention.py` add `decode_num_partitions` to the `ForwardMetadata` they build.

## Accuracy Tests

MI355X (gfx950), torch 2.11.0+rocm10.0.0, sglang-kernel 0.4.10, aiter `285579b62`, `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, `--attention-backend aiter`, bf16, otherwise default server args. Base is main `cb55d77d37`. GSM8K with `python -m sglang.test.run_eval --eval-name gsm8k --num-examples 1319 --temperature 0 --max-tokens 4096` (1314 questions after the 5 few-shot examples):

| Model | Base | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct | 0.8067 / 0.8075 / 0.8097 (mean 0.8080) | 0.8082 / 0.8067 / 0.8044 (mean 0.8064) |
| Qwen3-8B | 0.9482 / 0.9444 / 0.9490 (mean 0.9472) | 0.9444 / 0.9475 / 0.9460 (mean 0.9460) |

Greedy outputs already differ between base runs. With a fourth base run, the share of questions scored the same is 96.75% base vs base and 96.27% base vs PR for Llama, 98.22% and 98.22% for Qwen3.

Unit tests: `test_aiter_decode_partition_buckets.py` fails 6/6 on main and passes 6/6 here. It covers the bucket table, selection boundaries (4096 / 4097 / 32768 / 32769), eager and capture partition counts, spec decode, and bit-exact output against `max_num_partitions` for bf16 and fp8 KV; a negative case checks that 16 partitions with a 4097-token request give a different result. The two touched aiter tests pass.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Microbench of `paged_attention_ragged` (32 q / 8 kv heads, head_dim 128, bf16 KV, page size 1), 32 calls captured in one CUDA graph, median of 100 replays, µs per call. `-` means fewer partitions than the sequence needs. Output is bit-identical to the smallest valid P in every case except batch 256 / 32768 tokens at P=512.

| Batch | Max seq | P=16 | P=32 | P=128 | P=160 | P=512 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8 | 1536 | 16.8 | 17.3 | 17.6 | 17.7 | 25.0 |
| 64 | 1536 | 76.8 | 77.1 | 78.5 | 75.0 | 96.6 |
| 256 | 1536 | 294.7 | 298.8 | 319.7 | 340.7 | 568.4 |
| 64 | 8192 | - | 368.0 | 371.9 | 370.3 | 409.1 |
| 64 | 16384 | - | - | 710.2 | 704.9 | 760.3 |
| 64 | 32768 | - | - | 1449.7 | 1446.6 | 1480.8 |

`python -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang --dataset-name random --random-range-ratio 1.0`, server `--attention-backend aiter --disable-radix-cache`; the mixed row uses `--dataset-name custom` with 304 prompts of 1024 tokens and 16 of 40000 tokens. Blocks of 4 runs in the order base, PR, PR, base; the first run of each block is dropped and each block reports the median of runs 2-4. Base and PR are the means of their two blocks; noise is the second base block vs the first.

| Workload (input / output, concurrency) | Output throughput, base → PR (tok/s) | Median TPOT, base → PR (ms) | Noise, throughput / TPOT |
|---|---|---|---|
| Llama 1024 / 1024, c64 | 7076 → 7657 (+8.2%) | 7.55 → 6.86 (−9.1%) | +0.3% / +0.3% |
| Llama 1024 / 1024, c256 | 8731 → 12740 (+45.9%) | 26.47 → 17.19 (−35.1%) | −0.5% / +0.5% |
| Qwen3 1024 / 1024, c64 | 7144 → 7254 (+1.5%) | 7.40 → 7.26 (−1.9%) | +0.4% / −0.4% |
| Qwen3 1024 / 1024, c256 | 10670 → 11810 (+10.7%) | 21.05 → 18.74 (−11.0%) | +0.2% / −0.2% |
| Llama 60000 / 256, c4 | 101.5 → 101.6 (+0.05%) | 20.26 → 20.30 (+0.2%) | 0.0% / +0.05% |
| Qwen3 30000 / 256, c8 | 218.5 → 218.4 (−0.06%) | 23.71 → 23.65 (−0.3%) | −0.5% / +0.3% |
| Llama 8192 / 512, c32 | 1729 → 1758 (+1.7%) | 14.69 → 14.37 (−2.2%) | −0.6% / +0.5% |
| Llama 1024 / 1024 with 5% of prompts at 40000, c64 | 2253 → 2255 (+0.08%) | 23.74 → 23.80 (+0.3%) | +0.1% / −0.3% |

The TPOT drops match the microbench: P=512 vs 16 at batch 64 and 256 accounts for 0.63 and 8.8 ms per Llama step (measured 0.69 and 9.3 ms); P=160 vs 16 at batch 256 accounts for 1.7 ms per Qwen3 step (measured 2.3 ms). TTFT changes by at most 1.0%.

Startup, median over all server logs of the runs above (decode graphs for batch sizes up to 512): Llama capture 8.0 s → 13.1 s, graph memory 1.61 → 1.81 GB; Qwen3 8.3 s → 11.2 s, 1.43 → 1.54 GB. `max_total_num_tokens` is unchanged (1698595 and 1508113).

MI325X (gfx942), torch 2.11.0+rocm10.0.0, aiter `285579b62`, main `cb55d77d37` with this patch, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, same method: 1024 / 1024 c64 5086 → 5335 tok/s (+4.9%, noise 0.0%), TPOT 11.71 → 11.12 ms; c256 6137 → 8181 tok/s (+33.3%, noise +0.1%), TPOT 38.79 → 28.33 ms. GSM8K 0.8272 base vs 0.8265 PR; test_aiter_decode_partition_buckets.py and the two touched aiter tests pass.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch: @@ -1912,6 +1912,11 @@ SGLang supports various environment variables that can be used to configure its Let gfx950 fp8 hd256 chunked prefill read the KV pool in place through AITER's paged-varlen ASM kernel, instead of gathering the prefix into a contiguous buffer first. The ASM kernel is compiled for a 4D LINEAR [N, 64, H, D] KV cache, so it serves --page-size 64 on the NHD pool and nothing else; at any other page size this variable has no effect whichever way it is set. Where it does apply, the gain grows with context and is flat to marginally negative at moderate ISL, so set it to false for workloads that are not long-context. true + + SGLANG_AITER_DECODE_PARTITION_BUCKETS + Launch AITER paged_attention_ragged decode with fewer partitions for batches of short requests, through one decode CUDA graph per sequence-length bucket. Set to false to keep max_num_partitions for every decode. + true + SGLANG_ROCM_FUSED_DECODE_MLA Use the fused decode MLA kernel on ROCm.

@@ -662,6 +662,8 @@ class Envs:
     # switch rather than a pure kill-switch. Off falls back to the contiguous
     # gather path. Default on.
     SGLANG_AITER_PAGED_PREFILL_ASM = EnvBool(True)
+    # Bucket aiter paged_attention_ragged decode partitions by sequence length.
+    SGLANG_AITER_DECODE_PARTITION_BUCKETS = EnvBool(True)
     # size the KV pool after CUDA-graph capture
     SGLANG_ENABLE_POST_CAPTURE_KV_SIZING = EnvBool(False)

@@ -31,10 +31,14 @@
     resolve_window_id_space,
     resolve_window_kv_pool,
 )
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.graph_variants import SeqLenBucketGraphVariants
 from sglang.srt.layers.dcp import update_local_kv_lens_for_dcp
 from sglang.srt.layers.dcp.planner import plan_dcp_decode_metadata
 from sglang.srt.layers.dp_attention import is_dp_attention_enabled
 from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch, ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner_utils.capture_mode import (
+    get_capture_attention_variant,
+)
 from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_utils import (
     draft_kv_indices_buffer_width,

+"""Sequence-length buckets for the partition count of aiter paged_attention_ragged decode.
+
+``AiterAttnBackend`` launches the kernel with fewer partitions for batches of short
+requests, through one decode graph per bucket and a matching count in eager mode.
+Partitions past a request's length exit early, so any count that covers the longest
+request gives the same output; a count that does not drops KV silently.
+"""

+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase

+    )
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner_utils.capture_mode import (
+        _set_capture_attention_variant,

+
+_DEVICE = "cuda"
+_NUM_Q_HEADS = 32
+_NUM_KV_HEADS = 8
+_HEAD_DIM = 128
+
+
+def _make_backend(context_len=131072, **flags):
+    backend = object.__new__(AiterAttnBackend)
+    backend.use_mla = flags.get("use_mla", False)
+    backend.use_triton_unified_attention = flags.get("unified", False)
+    backend.kv_cache_is_vectorized_5d = flags.get("vec5d", False)
+    backend.max_context_len = context_len
+    backend.max_num_partitions = -(-context_len // _AITER_PARTITION_SIZE_ROCM)
+    backend._decode_partition_buckets = backend._build_decode_partition_buckets()
+    return backend
+
+
+def _variants(backend, mode=None, width=1):
+    return backend.get_decode_graph_variants(mode or ForwardMode.DECODE, width)
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(_RUNNABLE, "requires HIP with AITER")
+class TestDecodePartitionBucketTable(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_bucket_table(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            _make_backend(131072)._decode_partition_buckets,
+            (("p16", 4096, 16), ("p128", 32768, 128), ("pmax", 131072, 512)),
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            _make_backend(40960)._decode_partition_buckets,
+            (("p16", 4096, 16), ("pmax", 40960, 160)),

+        # No variants: too few partitions, other decode kernels, other modes, switch off.
+        backends = [_make_backend(16384)] + [
+            _make_backend(**{flag: True}) for flag in ("use_mla", "unified", "vec5d")
+        ]
+        with envs.SGLANG_AITER_DECODE_PARTITION_BUCKETS.override(False):
+            backends.append(_make_backend())
+        for backend in backends:
+            self.assertIsNone(_variants(backend))
+        for mode, width in (

+    def test_boundaries(self):
+        backend = _make_backend()

+
+    def _forward_batch(self, seq_lens, spec_info=None):
+        lens = torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32)
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            batch_size=len(seq_lens),
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.DECODE,
+            spec_info=spec_info,

+            seq_lens_sum=int(lens.sum()),

+            layer_id=0,

+            tp_k_head_num=_NUM_KV_HEADS,
+            tp_v_head_num=_NUM_KV_HEADS,
+            qk_head_dim=_HEAD_DIM,
+            v_head_dim=_HEAD_DIM,
+            k_scale=None,
+            v_scale=None,
+            sliding_window_size=-1,
+            logit_cap=0.0,
+            scaling=_HEAD_DIM**-0.5,
+        )
+        gen = torch.Generator(_DEVICE).manual_seed(1)
+        q = torch.randn(
+            forward_batch.batch_size,
+            _NUM_Q_HEADS * _HEAD_DIM,
+            device=_DEVICE,
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            generator=gen,
+        )
+        return backend.forward_decode(
+            q, None, None, layer, forward_batch, save_kv_cache=False
+        )

+    def test_eager_decode_matches_max_partitions(self):
+        cases = (
+            ([1, 4095, 4096], 16),
+            ([4097, 1], 128),
+            ([32768, 300, 4097], 128),
+            ([32769, 5], 512),

+                    self.assertTrue(torch.equal(out, ref))
